item.title: [6.5] DirectSpeech2LLM: A Simple End-to-End Framework to Mitigate Prompt Overfitting in Speech-LLMs
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Speech-LLMs often exhibit prompt overfitting, where models solely trained on automatic speech recognition (ASR) instruction fail to generalize to new instructions such as speech translation and continue to behave primarily as ASR system. We propose DirectSpeech2LLM, a simple end-to-end framework that preserves the instruction-following ability of the LLM on unseen tasks when conditioned on...

WHY IT MATTERS

DirectSpeech2LLM presents a novel alignment framework that mitigates prompt overfitting in speech-LLMs, enabling zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks using only ASR training data.
